title: Projection-compatible Roos presentation of system direct image
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite extension E/Q_ell. Let f:X→Y be an arbitrary morphism of schemes, with the actual additive sectionwise quotient-system direct image and K-injective resolutions for the source system category [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems, def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. Let S be a normalized CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus on X [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], and let K be any object of the ordinary unbounded derived category over the completed integral coefficients on X. Put N=Rf_system(S.reduction(K)). There exist the product of the finite direct-image terms, a Roos presentation L:SfIntegralDirectImage(f,K) [def-weil-derived-direct-image], an isomorphism e:coefficientSequenceLimit(N) ≅ L.obj, and isomorphisms a_n:e_n(N) ≅ sfFiniteDerivedDirectImage(f,K,n), such that for every n≥0, the actual limit projection of N followed by completed-scalar restriction of (a_n).hom equals e.hom followed by the nth projection of L. No completeness, boundedness, constructibility, finite-type or invertibility-on-schemes assumption is imposed, and no reconstruction counit is asserted invertible.

proof.text: Choose one K-injective representative of S.reduction(K) on the actual ringed sequence site. The section-normalized derived direct-image evaluation comparison, followed by finite direct image of S.reductionEvaluation, gives isomorphisms a_n:e_n(Rf_system S.reduction(K)) ≅ Rf_n(K tensor^L A_(n+1)). This construction uses one system representative, not independent choices of finite derived objects.

proof.text: Use the resolution-normalized direct-image restriction-transition equation (with the identity open immersion) and the strict quotient transition clause of S.reductionModel. After restriction to completed coefficients, the resulting transition under the a_n is sfDirectImageTransition: both are obtained by transporting the source reduction transition through the canonical restriction/direct-image comparison. The ordinary comparison is identity on sections; localization on a simultaneous K-injective resolution fixes the derived square. Thus this is equality of the actual restricted tower arrows, not reconstruction of a derived morphism from finite components.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21; Lemma 4.10, printed pp. 23--24; Stacks Tag 0941. Projection-compatible model comparison in steps 1--2 of lem-weil-system-direct-image-effectivity.

proof.text: The projection-normalized constant-tower Roos comparison computes the specified total limit. Transport its product terms by restriction of the a_n. The previous transition equality intertwines the endomorphisms 1-shift, so the transported distinguished triangle defines SfIntegralDirectImage L. Taking its first-vertex comparison e gives e.hom followed by the nth Roos projection equal to the actual total-limit projection followed by restriction of (a_n).hom. Products exist for these pro-etale completed-module towers. This proves the assertion without any completeness or constructibility assumption.

from.place: Direct-image Roos presentation, isolated as the projection-compatible model comparison used in steps 1--2 of lem-weil-system-direct-image-effectivity.

lean.statement:
theorem systemDirectImage_roosPresentation
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [(integralComparisonSequenceDirectImage l E f).Additive]
    [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions (coefficientSequenceModules l E X)]
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X)
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) :
    let N := (integralComparisonSequenceDirectImage l E f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
      (S.reduction.obj K)
    ∃ hprod : HasProduct (sfDirectImageTerm l E f K),
      ∃ L : @SfIntegralDirectImage l _ E _ _ _ X Y f K hprod,
        ∃ e : (coefficientSequenceLimit l E Y).obj N ≅ L.obj,
          ∃ a : ∀ n : ℕ, (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Y n).obj N ≅
            sfFiniteDerivedDirectImage l E f K n,
            ∀ n : ℕ, (coefficientSequenceProjection l E Y n).app N ≫
                (coefficientFiniteDerivedRestriction l E Y n).map (a n).hom =
              e.hom ≫ L.projection ≫ Pi.π (sfDirectImageTerm l E f K) n
